tools.name: kg_search
tools.description: Find nodes by name, id, path, code or words, best first; a plan step, section or document is followed by the files, symbols and documents it mentions. Past the first 5, a result shows its id alone. Returns ids to pass to kg_node or kg_context.

query.description: name, id, path, code or words

deprecated.description: also show nodes and edges a decision deprecated

tools.name: kg_context
tools.description: A connected subgraph around a question or a set of ids. Its nodes and edges together stay within budget_tokens; what did not fit is counted.

budget_tokens.description: size of the whole text, as UTF-8 bytes / 3

deprecated.description: also show nodes and edges a decision deprecated

tools.name: kg_node
tools.description: One node: properties, status, label, evidence (source, revision, span, uri) and its edges; a node a decision deprecated says so, with its reason.

deprecated.description: also show nodes and edges a decision deprecated

tools.name: kg_impact
tools.description: What a change reaches: give node ids, repo:path paths or a unified diff. Walks back over callers (in other files too), importers, members, definers, dependants, implementations, tests, subclasses (inherits) and overriding methods (overrides); documents that mention a reached node come back as a separate group to re-check. Each hop lists its first `limit` dependents, strongest first, and counts the rest. Each result notes, per language of its seeds, whether calls across files, inheritance and overrides are covered, and names a seed with more incoming edges than it reads, with their number.

paths.description: the files to change: repo:path, or a bare path

diff.description: a unified diff, e.g. the output of git diff

limit.description: dependents listed per hop, and a quarter as many documents; the rest are counted

deprecated.description: also show nodes and edges a decision deprecated

tools.name: kg_path
tools.description: How two nodes connect: the shortest path from one to the other, preferring stronger status. Without 'to', the chains from one node along implements, schedules, verifies, has_step and touches.

deprecated.description: also show nodes and edges a decision deprecated

tools.name: kg_status
tools.description: Bound project, sink profile, snapshot age, and coverage per source.
